description: Muse's verified report of a browser run, carried by HeavenzFire Interchange v1. This package is the ONLY proof a browser action happened. A request package alone proves nothing. Every claim carries evidence or is listed under unresolved. IDs and messages are verbatim from the site.

checked.description: What was actually checked or done, step by step, in the live session or fetch. Distinguish 'read the terms page' from 'signed in and read the account page'.

confirmations.description: Empty array means the site issued no confirmation — which for purchase/send actions means the action is NOT established.

kind.description: e.g. order_id, tracking_number, total_charged, mailing_date, account_name, confirmation_text.

value.description: Verbatim from the site. Never reconstructed, rounded, or inferred.

basis.description: search_snippet is the weakest basis and cannot establish live availability, prices, or account state.

source_url.description: Exact URL the claim rests on, copied verbatim from the session/search result.

message.description: The site's exact error message where one exists, quoted. If the failure was a dead session / no response, say exactly that — do not invent a site message.

request_id.description: Echoes the request package's request_id verbatim. A result that cannot be matched to a request is not trusted.

source_platform.description: Results are always produced by Muse, the side that ran the browser.

status.description: unknown is mandatory when a session died / no result came back: a dead session may or may not have committed, and must be re-checked state-first before any retry.

unresolved.description: Anything still open: questions the browser asked that weren't answered, approvals still pending, fields the site did not show.

title: Browser Result Package (Muse -> GPT)
